release_name: Live TV v5.1.5 — 100% Zero-Scroll Phone TV & Pure Hardware TV Remote
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 📱 100% Zero-Scroll Phone TV Viewport: Re-engineered CSS layout with dynamic in-flow bottom nav and bounded flexbox, completely eliminating vertical scroll on iOS Safari and Android Chrome
🎮 Dedicated Hardware TV Remote: Pure remote control controller with zero player elements, unified steppers (CH, Quality, VOL), hardware circular D-Pad, and collapsible keypad drawer
🎯 Scoped Mini Player Bar: Now-playing Mac sync bar is strictly scoped to the Channels browser tab and permanently hidden on the Remote and Phone TV tabs
⚡ Ultra-Fast 0ms Latency: Hardware-accelerated touch targets and responsive flex bounds across all mobile screens
🛡️ 100% Ad-Free Live TV (Zero-Ad Shield): Zero commercial interruptions across all 2,989 channels
